ballByBall.commentary: The leg-spinner fires a length ball down leg, and Tilak Varma tries to flick but misses, struck on the pad for a dot ball.
Mujeeb fires in a carrom ball back of a length outside off, and Tilak Varma works it away, though the shot is mis-timed. Mujeeb fields at mid-wicket as they take a single.
Mujeeb sends down an off break outside off on a length, and Tilak Varma’s mistimed flick rolls straight back to the bowler for a dot ball.
Back of a length, outside off; Tilak flicks along the ground to deep mid-wicket for one run.
Rashid Khan fires in a back-of-a-length googly down leg. Tilak works it away but cannot score and is run out by a direct hit from Rashid Khan.
